name: ASTARTES
text: A Plague Marine may double up in one activation: two Shoots or two Fights. A double Shoot must use a bolt weapon or a PSYCHIC weapon at least once, and never the same PSYCHIC gun twice. Its order never stops it counteracting.

name: Disgustingly Resilient
text: Each attack die that would hurt a Plague Marine for 3 or more gets a D6 roll; a 4+ shaves 1 off that die. Damage that does not come from an attack die (Poison, Flail, Hot, Curse of Rot and the like) is never reduced.

name: Poison
text: Once a success from this weapon damages the target, it is marked with one of your Poison tokens (one at most, and never on your own Plague Marines). A marked operative loses 1 wound each time it is activated.
source: wahapedia kill-teams plague-marines; docs/spec/13-teams.md T-PM.17, T-PM.18

name: Toxic
text: +1 to both Dmg values against any target that already carried your Poison token when this action started; each target is judged on its own.

name: PSYCHIC
text: A tag with no effect of its own. Rules such as Astartes read it to know which weapons are psychic.

name: Grandfather's Blessing
text: The Champion heals as poisoned foes suffer: each wound a poisoned enemy within 7 inches loses gives it one back, at most 3 per turning point, never above its starting wounds, and only while it is still standing.

name: Grenadier
text: The Bombardier carries its own blight and krak grenades at Hit 3+, and its blight grenades have Toxic. They do not use any grenade uses the team picked from equipment.

name: FLAIL
text: The Fighter whirls its flail: roll D3+2 damage separately for every other operative, friend or foe, it can see within 2 inches. An enemy whose D3 came up 3 is also poisoned if it was not. Counts as a Fight for action limits and Astartes, needs no enemy in reach, and cannot be used on Conceal.

name: Icon Bearer
text: Adds 1 to its APL in the marker-control count only. Its real APL is unchanged, so APL changes still apply on top.

name: Icon of Contagion
text: Contagion is free (0 CP) for you while any part of this operative stands in the enemy territory.

name: POISONOUS MIASMA
text: Choose an enemy the Plaguecaster can see within 7 inches, or any enemy it could legally pick as a target. An unpoisoned enemy is poisoned; a poisoned one loses 3 wounds instead. Not usable with an enemy in control range.

name: PUTRESCENT VITALITY
text: Heal a friend the Plaguecaster can see within 3 inches (itself included): roll two dice; a total of exactly 7 restores 7 wounds, any other roll restores as many as the higher die. Once per turning point, and not with an enemy in control range.

name: Repulsive Fortitude
text: Against shooting attacks, this operative counts defence rolls of 5 as well as 6 as critical saves.
